Get KZS Play-by-Play

Source: R/kzs.R
kzs_pbp.Rd

Play-by-play of a final game (2015/16 on, with gaps), one row per action with shot x/y.

Endpoint: GET https://api.kzs.si/api/v1/public/matches/{match_id}/playByPlay

Usage

kzs_pbp(match_id)

Arguments

match_id

(required) Match id (match_id in kzs_matches), e.g. 101839. Global across seasons.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Play-by-play of a final game (2015/16 on, with gaps), one row per action with shot x/y. An empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py kzs_pbp):

col_nametypedescription
match_idintegerMatch id: the federation key of a game, global across seasons (joins kzs_matches and kzs_match).
action_numberinteger1-based position of the action in the feed, which is in game order.
team_sidecharacterWhich side of the match the row belongs to: home (the organiser, firstTeam on the wire) or away.
sourcecharacterFeed the action came from: GENIUS_SPORTS in every sample.
clockcharacterTime remaining in the period, 'MM:SS:CC' (minutes, seconds, hundredths): '09:56:00' = 9:56 left.
action_typecharacterAction type (code table).
sub_typecharacterAction subtype (” when none; code table).
qualifierscharacterSemicolon-separated qualifiers (” when none; code table).
xdoubleLocation along the court length, 0-100 percent (see the coordinate section): shots, and from 2020-21 fouls and turnovers; 0.0 when the row has no location.
ydoubleLocation across the court width, 0-100 percent (see the coordinate section); 0.0 when the row has no location.
areacharacterCourt zone of the action (code table): set on shots, and from 2020-21 on located fouls and turnovers; ” on rows without a location and on every shot of early 2015-16 games.
sidecharacterBasket end: LEFT (x~0) or RIGHT (x~100). Absent on non-shot rows before 2020-21 and on some 2020-21 rows (read absent on a shot as LEFT).
successlogicalTrue when the shot / free throw was made (true on non-shot rows).
score1integerFirst (home) team score after the action, a numeric STRING.
score2integerSecond (away) team score after the action, a numeric STRING.
periodintegerPeriod number; overtime restarts at 1 with periodType OVERTIME.
period_typecharacterREGULAR or OVERTIME.
partcharacterPeriod label: QUARTER1-QUARTER4, then OT1 (OT2 and on by the same pattern, unobserved).
match_team_player_idintegerMatch-player id: the player's entry in this one match; NOT the player id. No captured route is keyed by it: join on playerId on the same row.
player_idintegerPlayer id (KZS player registry). Joins to /players/{playerId}, box-score and play-by-play playerId.
match_team_player_first_namecharacterThe acting player's given name, as entered for this match.
match_team_player_last_namecharacterThe acting player's family name, as entered for this match.
team_application_idintegerTeam-application id: the team's registration (entry) for the season; play-by-play teamApplicationId is the same key space.
team_namecharacterTeam name for the season, sponsor included (e.g. 'Perspektiva Ilirija').
match_team_idintegerMatch-team id: this team's entry in this one match (unique per match and side). Joins to play-by-play matchTeamId; NOT a team id.
player_photo_uuidcharacterPlayer photo: image file id, served at https://api.kzs.si/public/images/{uuid}.
shirt_numbercharacterShirt number worn by the acting player, sent as a string.

Details

  • Unofficial and unsupported: these wrappers read the public read API (Java/Spring, built by OnixWeb) that the kzs.si site itself calls. No terms of use were located (unverified), api.kzs.si/robots.txt answers 401 and www.kzs.si/robots.txt 404, so no policy or Crawl-delay is published. The runtime waits at least 1 s before every request, retries included. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

  • Personal data: the API serves officials' and coaches' emails, phones and home towns, and clubs' bank accounts and addresses, publicly. The parsers never output them (officials appear by name only; club addresses, personnel and the commissioner report are dropped). Do not add them back.

  • Seasons are END years (2027 = 2026/2027); KZS' own season ids are opaque (27 = 2026/2027) and the runtime maps them. Competition ids are per season. Three team keys are never interchangeable: the match-team id (per match and side), team_id (one club team in one season) and club_id (across seasons). player_id is the registry id, person_id the person behind it.

  • Errors are HTTP 400 for everything (an unknown id and a bad parameter alike), so the runtime raises hoopR_asset_fetch for it, never hoopR_bad_request or an empty frame. List routes default to 150 rows with no truncation signal: every list wrapper asks for a large limit and refuses a full page. The play-by-play and box-score wrappers, the leaderboards, teams, rounds and playing days each make one extra, cached request (the match header or the competition) to prove the answer is the one asked for and the game is final.

  • Coverage: scores from 2007/08; box scores and play-by-play from 2015/16. Some 2020/21 men's games have a box score but no play-by-play (hoopR_no_data): the Genius data.json (genius_match_id in kzs_matches) is the fallback. Shot x/y are Genius court percent; side (LEFT/RIGHT) names the basket end and teams switch ends at half time, so normalise with side before stacking shots. Advanced box-score fields are 0 in every observed game.

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (an empty answer or list, a competition without standings, a final game with no play-by-play or box score, HTTP 404), hoopR_asset_fetch (HTTP 400, the API's only error status for an unknown id and a bad parameter alike; any other non-2xx; a non-JSON or empty body; an envelope whose status is not OK; a full list page; a game that is not final; a body for another competition, match, team, player or season than the one asked for) and hoopR_bad_request (a bad argument, before any request). HTTP 500 is retried. Wrappers raise; they never return an empty frame for a failed fetch.
